mechanism: Remove excess existing bookings while preserving an explicitly selected survivor in each itinerary group; cancellation permission changes with observed cancellations and cannot be inferred from a stale inventory.
user_request_draft: File 1 is my authoritative initial inventory of active bookings, including itinerary_group, passenger, flight, confirmation and paid price. Within each group, retain the booking with the lowest paid price; ties use the lexicographically smallest confirmation. You may cancel the other listed bookings only while the retained booking is still known active. A successful cancellation removes that confirmation from the active set; an ambiguous result requires stopping. Do not cancel the retained booking or the last remaining booking in any group, mix groups/passengers, or buy new tickets. Initial inventory is a snapshot, not evidence that a booking remains active after a cancellation in this task.
new_relation: preserve at least one actual booking
potential_overlap: Shares preserve-old-ticket concern with development rebooking, but operates on an initial multiset without new purchases. Reviewer must assess whether set-based survivor selection is a sufficiently distinct task mechanism.
